func IsBlankLookingName(name string) bool // IsBlankLookingName reports whether a name is made only of characters that show as nothing or as white space: the ASCII and ideographic spaces, the Hangul fillers U+3164, U+FFA0, U+115F and U+1160, the braille blank U+2800, and combining marks (Unicode category M), which have no base character to attach to when nothing else is there.

  func (*Sessions).Delete(ctx context.Context, token string) error // Delete ends the session with this token, if there is one.
  func (*Sessions).DeleteExpired(ctx context.Context) error // DeleteExpired removes sessions that have expired by now.
  func (*Sessions).Replace(ctx context.Context, previousToken string, accountID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (string, time.Time, error) // Replace starts a session for the account and, in the same transaction, ends the session named by previousToken (the browser's cookie, possibly empty or stale).
  func (*Sessions).Resolve(ctx context.Context, token string) (Account, Session, error) // Resolve returns the account and session of a live session.
